args.title: Ironbark Tooling Newsletter Summary – Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter (Ironbark Tooling): "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" highlights how live sensor data sharing among carriers is reshaping cold-chain operations, linking to a full article on the topic.
- Linked article: Found that temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data in transit; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece (registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): Reports that pilot programs using this live data-sharing approach cut claims by a quarter, reinforcing the main article's findings on reduced rejections/losses.
